name: Bright Addons Blocks Library
author: nayem07

sections.description:
Bright Addons Blocks Library adds 51 polished, ready-to-use blocks to the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg). Every block is set up from the sidebar – no code, no page builder, no extra framework.

Built by the team behind Bright Addons for Elementor, with the same clean design.

Why Bright Addons Blocks

  • Fast. Each block loads only its own small CSS file, and only on pages that use it. Scripts are tiny, plain JavaScript with no jQuery.
  • Switch off what you don’t need. Turn any block on or off from Bright Blocks in your dashboard. Switched-off blocks don’t load at all.
  • Accessible. Keyboard-friendly tabs, accordion and sliders, proper ARIA roles, visible focus styles and support for “reduce motion”.
  • Works with your theme. Blocks follow your theme’s fonts and work with block themes and classic themes. Wide and full-width alignment is supported.
  • SEO-friendly. Real headings you choose, clean markup and optional FAQ, Recipe and Event schema (JSON-LD).
  • Live preview. What you see in the editor is exactly what visitors see.
  • Translation ready.

The 51 blocks

Content

  • Advanced Heading – pre-title, highlighted phrase (gradient, color, underline or marker), separator and subtitle.
  • Info Box – icon, title with an optional Free/Pro/New tag, text and link. Make the whole box clickable.
  • Icon List – icons, links and Free/Pro/New/Hot tags before or after the text; stacked, multi-column or inline.
  • Feature List – features with icons and a connector line.
  • Card – image card with badge, title, text and a link.
  • Flip Box – a card that flips on hover, focus or tap.
  • Advanced Tabs – horizontal or vertical tabs in three styles.
  • FAQ Accordion – native, lightweight accordion with optional FAQ schema.
  • Alert / Notice – info, success, warning and error messages that visitors can close.
  • Pros and Cons – two lists side by side.
  • Tag Icon Box – icon box with a Free/Pro/New/Hot or custom-colour tag before, after or above the title.
  • Advanced Divider – lines in several styles with text, an icon or both in the middle.
  • Blockquote – five quote styles with drop cap, author photo, role and source link.
  • Code Block – syntax highlighting for 25 languages, line numbers, highlighted lines, file name and a copy button.
  • Simple Table – type rows with | between cells; striped, bordered, and stacked cards on phones.
  • Recipe Card – times, servings, ingredients you can tick off, steps with photos, print button and Recipe schema.

Numbers and ratings

  • Counter – counts up when it scrolls into view.
  • Progress Bars – animated bars for skills or goals.
  • Stat Card – a key number with its change and a small trend chart.
  • Star Rating – half stars, score and label.
  • Review Score Box – overall score ring, rating bars per category and a verdict.

Marketing

  • Call to Action – headline, text and buttons on a gradient, dark or light background.
  • Dual Button – two buttons with an optional “or” connector.
  • Pricing Table – plan, price, features and a featured badge.
  • Countdown Timer – for launches, sales and events (uses your site time zone).
  • Coupon Code – a discount code with one-click copy.
  • Testimonial Carousel – swipeable reviews with arrows, dots and autoplay.
  • Logo Carousel – an endless, smooth logo marquee.
  • Floating Contact – WhatsApp, phone, email, Messenger and Telegram buttons fixed to a corner of the screen.
  • QR Code – for links, text, email, phone, SMS or Wi-Fi, with dot styles, colours, logo and download.
  • Event Card – upcoming events with dates in your time zone, past events hidden automatically and Event schema.
  • Job Listing – open positions with team, location and type filters.

Site and contact

  • Site Logo – your site logo or title with tagline, linked home.
  • Copyright – © year range, site name and footer links that update themselves.
  • Contact Info – phone, email, address, hours and more, linked automatically.
  • Social Icons – profile links or share buttons for 14 networks plus email in brand, outline or custom colours.
  • Ajax Search – live search results as you type, with keyboard support; works as a normal search form without JavaScript.

Forms (shown when the form plugin is active)

  • Contact Form 7 Styler, WPForms Styler, Gravity Forms Styler and Fluent Forms Styler – pick a form and give it outlined, filled or underline fields, your colours, rounded corners and a full-width button.

People, media and posts

  • Team Member – photo, name, role, bio and social links.
  • Image Comparison – a before/after slider that works with mouse, touch and keyboard.
  • Post Grid – your latest posts as cards, with category, date, reading time and excerpt.
  • Recent Posts – a compact list with thumbnails or numbers for sidebars and footers.
  • Post Info – date, author, categories, comments and reading time for the current post.
  • Image Gallery – a grid with captions, hover effects and a keyboard-friendly lightbox.
  • Image Mask – images in blob, arch, hexagon and other shapes, with a shape behind and gentle motion.
  • Image Stack – layered images and floating info cards for hero sections.
  • SVG Draw – line drawings that draw themselves in on scroll, load or hover.
  • PDF Viewer – show a PDF on the page with download and open buttons.

Bright Addons Pro

Want more? Bright Addons Pro adds more blocks, Elementor widgets and extensions under one licence. This free plugin is complete on its own – nothing in it is locked.

Credits

  • Outline icons from Lucide – ISC License.
  • Brand icons from Simple Icons – CC0 1.0.
  • Syntax highlighting in the Code Block by Prism 1.30.0 – MIT License, © Lea Verou. Unminified source in blocks/code-block/prism.js.
  • QR codes by qrcode-generator 2.0.4 – MIT License, © Kazuhiko Arase. Source in blocks/qr-code/qrcode-generator.js. “QR Code” is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins › Add New, search for Bright Addons Blocks Library and click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Open any post or page in the block editor and click the + inserter. You’ll find all blocks in the Bright Addons category.
  3. Optional: go to Bright Blocks in the dashboard menu to switch off blocks you don’t use.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor?

No. This plugin is for the WordPress block editor. If you use Elementor, see our separate plugin, Bright Addons for Elementor.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Each block loads its own small stylesheet and script only on pages where that block is used. There are no external requests, no jQuery and no icon fonts – icons are inline SVG.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. The blocks inherit your theme’s fonts and work with block themes (Twenty Twenty-Five, etc.) and classic themes.

How do I change colors?

Select the block and open the Colors panel in the block sidebar. Every block uses the brand colors by default and you can pick your own.

Does the FAQ block add schema?

Yes, it can output FAQPage schema (JSON-LD) for search engines. Switch it off in the block settings if you don’t want it.

Which time zone does the countdown use?

Your site time zone from Settings › General. The Event Card uses it too.

Do the form stylers include a form builder?

No. They style forms you made in Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms or Fluent Forms. Each styler block only appears in the inserter when its form plugin is active.

Does the Ajax Search block send data anywhere?

No. It asks your own site’s REST API for matching published posts and pages. Only the post types you chose in the block can be searched, and private or password-protected content is never returned.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. All text in the plugin can be translated on translate.wordpress.org.

Where is the source code?

All JavaScript and CSS in the plugin is the original, human-readable source. There is no build step.
